definitions.abs_error: a - b (observed minus reported), per item
definitions.rel_error: (a - b) / b, only when b >= min_base (default 10) to avoid unstable ratios on small counts
definitions.WAPE: sum |a - b| / sum b; undefined when sum b = 0
definitions.pearson: Pearson correlation of a and b over items (needs >= 3 items and variance)
definitions.spearman: Spearman rank correlation (average ranks for ties)
definitions.jaccard: |A and B| / |A or B| for route sets
definitions.note: a = ADS-B observations (this dataset), b = official statistic. Coverage differs, so these are conditional external comparisons, not accuracy.
